findings: The eight exact QOM names and bool/u32/u64 widths match the committed model; integer validation excludes Python bool and bounds values to their unsigned widths.
Two complete QOM snapshots are read between stopped query-status observations. A changed guest status raises; unequal snapshots cannot produce a complete observation.
The mask is checked against 0xffff, effective/ignored are derived independently from the raw word, and zero history is canonical.
Nonzero history requires the explicit policy, valid voter, valid voter-specific TCS geometry, and ignored bits. Strict profile cannot carry masked history.
Complete means a stable stopped observation under the enabled reference policy. A cold zero-use policy can be complete; accepted masked write is separately represented by its counter.
The observer does not compare historical last-event data with current guest WAIT, execute MMIO, set a property, advance virtual time, acknowledge an IRQ, or complete a command.
Claims explicitly exclude hardware reserved-bit semantics, driver probe success, userspace success and Android boot.
conclusion: No static blocker found in the bounded observer extension.
scope_limit: This is an independent static review, not confirmation of the author memory cases, a QMP execution, native progress, or an exact CI artifact result.
